snippet.title: Billie Bust Up - Official Gameplay and Demo Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Dive once more into the musical world of Billie Bust Up, and check out gameplay in this latest trailer for this upcoming 3D platformer that blends music, magic, and adventure in a world inspired by your favorite animated classics. Join Billie, a daring young goat, on a quest to uncover her father’s legacy and reclaim a powerful magic. With her mystical axolotl mentor Aristotle and loyal pet fox Oscar, you'll explore vibrant, whimsical realms, face off against quirky, song-slinging villains, and master incredible magical abilities. Billie Bust Up will be available on PC. A demo for Billie Bust Up is out now (June 3) until June 9, 2025.
